newsitem.title: TAIWAN: TAIWAN STOCKS - FACTORS TO WATCH - AUGUST 14.
newsitem.headline: TAIWAN STOCKS - FACTORS TO WATCH - AUGUST 14.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Taiwan stocks on Thursday:
* Benchmark stock index is expected to launch a technical rebound after three straight days of heavy falls.
* Index plunged 2.57 percent/251.62 points to close at 9,556.12 on Wednesday.
* Allen Huang, fund manager, National Securities: "A technical rebound is expected, but how strong the rebound will be depends on the performance of recent bellwether electronics."

* The index fell on Wednesday on Wall Street's and Nasdaq's Tuesday falls. Wall Street fell overnight, but Nasdaq rebounded, with semiconductor equipment makers strong. "Nasdaq's rebound should help electronics rebound," Huang said.
* Economic Daily News said on Thursday state-run postal funds and labour pension funds together bought T$200 million worth of stocks on Wednesday, a move seen helping sentiment.

* Sentiment was dampened amid worries of worsening social orders as three suspects allegedly involved in the kidnap and murder of a celebrity's daughter abducted another victim, a prosecutor said on Wednesday.
